name: LinkedIn Feed Post
strategic_objective: Thought leadership, industry credibility, conversation, and professional visibility.

tone: Professional, analytical, confident, and value-driven. Human but not casual.
copywriting_rules: The first one to two lines must communicate the core insight or tension to earn the 'see more' click. Use short paragraphs. Anchor ideas in real experience, data, or explicit learning. Avoid generic motivational language.
Line 1–2: core insight, tension, or question. Body: explanation, context, or mini-case. Final line: direct business-oriented CTA.
Focus on industry, role, and topic specificity. Avoid broad general tags.
Tag people or companies only when they are directly involved or referenced.

required_generation_elements: Clear insight or question in the first two lines
hard_constraints: Vague inspirational quotes with no business context
Hashtag-heavy blocks inside the main text
